title: research.recent
description: Recall recently synthesized research briefs from the node's local store, newest first. Backs 'what did I find on X' recall and the Research app's recent-briefs list without re-calling the language model. Each returned brief carries its query, sections, papers, and generatedAt timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent briefs to return. Default 10 if omitted; clamped to 50.
